capabilities: complete LaTeX commands triggered by backslash in math contexts
match Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and English keywords to LaTeX commands
define custom keyword-to-snippet mappings with tabstop placeholders
convert selected natural language text to LaTeX via an AI API
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX renderer or previewer; it only completes and inserts commands while typing in math contexts.
extras: The AI feature is optional; command completion works without any API configuration. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's Live Preview offers no command completion for LaTeX, and typing LaTeX commands is hard for users who think in Chinese, Japanese, or Korean.
summary: LaTeX autocomplete plugin that suggests 200+ commands in math contexts, matches CJK/English keywords to commands, and converts text to LaTeX via AI.
